message.content:
The bug is the truncation of the size computation to `unsigned int` on line 3. `prefix_len + name_len + 3` is computed in `size_t` but cast to `unsigned int`, so large attacker-influenced lengths can wrap around (e.g., to a small value), causing the capacity check on line 5 to pass and subsequent `memcpy` calls (lines 13–15) to overflow the undersized buffer.

Answer: 3
